text:
What does it mean to build something that lasts?
It’s more than passing the keys – it’s passing down values, responsibility and a deep commitment to community.

In Greene County, PA, Mark Fox is carrying on a 100-year legacy at Fox Ford. Three generations in, their story’s built on more than cars – it’s built on service, from firehouse runs to youth outreach.

In Georgia, the @billyhowellford family’s doing the same. Three generations strong, they’re feeding first responders, supporting shelters and even donating a Maverick to St. Jude.

And then there’s @allanvigilfl – Bronze Star Army vet who turned a struggling lot into Georgia’s largest Ford dealership. Since 1982, he’s built a legacy of leadership and service that his kids now carry forward.

Legacy isn’t just history. It’s horsepower – and it drives every handshake, every hometown, every mile.
